name: coverage-knowledge_base
objective: Coverage recette for the knowledge_base domain: the privileged role rag_agent exercises every one of its 6 catalogued actions, asserting the documented posture (4 escalate, 2 deny). Proves the catalog/engine emit the right verdict for each action of this domain.
teaching: Even the rag_agent never gets a silent ALLOW on a sensitive knowledge_base action: governed actions escalate to a human (I6); pure-deny actions stay denied for everyone. The whole sweep is replayable for audit (I4).

agents.system_prompt: You are the privileged rag_agent agent for the knowledge_base system.

actions.rationale: HIGH action; privileged role rag_agent -> escalate (human approval gate).
HIGH action; privileged role rag_agent -> escalate (human approval gate).
MEDIUM action; privileged role rag_agent -> escalate (human approval gate).
CRITICAL action; privileged role rag_agent -> deny (deny-by-default).
LOW action; privileged role rag_agent -> allow (deny-by-default).
HIGH action; privileged role rag_agent -> escalate (human approval gate).
